slot.brief: From a 2×2 probability table, compute a conditional probability and check independence of two events.

stem: The joint probabilities of events $A$ and $B$ are given below. Find $P(A\mid B)$ and determine whether $A$ and $B$ are independent. $$\begin{array}{c|cc} & B & B' \\ \hline A & \frac{1}{5} & \frac{1}{5} \\ A' & \frac{1}{10} & \frac{1}{2} \end{array}$$

verdicts.working: P(B)=\frac15+\frac1{10}=\frac3{10}, so P(A\mid B)=\frac{1/5}{3/10}=\frac23. Also P(A)=\frac25, and P(A)P(B)=\frac3{25}\ne P(A\cap B)=\frac15; hence dependent.

working:
$P(B)=\frac15+\frac1{10}=\frac3{10}$
$P(A\mid B)=\dfrac{1/5}{3/10}=\frac23$
$P(A)=\frac25,\quad P(A)P(B)=\frac{3}{25}\ne P(A\cap B)=\frac15$
